description: Département de la Seine Maritime: dams and flood defences datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Département de la Seine Maritime. Coverage: Département de la Seine Maritime. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about dams and flood defences; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Etude reglementaire Seine Digue Heurteauville 2017 11; Topographie digues Seine B1975 Plan de situation zone 5 PDF CD76 20150; Topographie digues Seine B1975 Plan de situation zone 5 CAD drawing CD. Formats seen: WEB PAGE. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
